reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Metrics namespace: Some Loki metrics started with the prefix `cortex_`. In this release they will be changed so they start with `loki_`. To keep them at…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Listed metrics are exposed with the `loki_` prefix instead of `cortex_`, so queries, dashboards or alerts using the old names will not match unless metrics_namespace is set to `cortex`.
consequence.remediation: Set metrics_namespace to `cortex` to keep old names, or update dashboards and alerts.

proposed.statement: Some Loki metrics' prefix changes from `cortex_` to `loki_` by default (metrics_namespace default `loki`); set `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` to keep the old prefix.
